text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today, invited by the editor with whom I had unexpectedly connected, I came to observe Mejiro Ramonu's magazine photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text: Allow me to explain once more. Our magazine is running a special feature on Ramonu-san. The theme is none other than "Jewels"!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text: And so, we've borrowed jewels from various places to shoot alongside her! The total value is reportedly several hundred million yen...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The sheer presence of the displayed jewels took my breath away. Glancing around, there were numerous security guards, and a tense atmosphere hung over the set. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: My, what a lovely necklace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ramonu changed into her racing silks, and the shoot began. Amid the echoing shutter clicks, gasps of admiration escaped the staff with every move she made.

text_block_list.name: Photoshoot Staff
text_block_list.text:
Haa... wonderful...
How can someone be so beautiful—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Surrounded by jewels, Mejiro Ramonu sat, reclined, and smiled... Her brilliance easily rivaled—if not surpassed—the multi-million-yen gems.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The photoshoot proceeded smoothly, and all scheduled steps were completed.
...Or so I had thought—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Now then, let us head to the track.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Huh?
P-Please wait...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Apparently, this was not part of the plan. Even so, everyone hurriedly packed up and followed Mejiro Ramonu, only to find—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Good grief, what a woman you are...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Only you would summon me with a single phone call.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You should be pleased, should you not? Otherwise, bound by duty as you are, you would never be able to take a single step.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
The "Emperor", Symboli Rudolf...
Ramonu-san, could you have brought a guest to liven up the shoot...?

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text: T-That's it, right?! Having Rudolf-san as your partner to showcase two absolute and flawless figures!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: How fanciful of you. Rudolf is just like those jewels.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Merely there to accentuate me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I know. If that is what you desire... I shall brace myself and give my all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...You all, be careful not to gaze too intently. She is dangerous, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: An impromptu mock race between two legends took place. Its intensity went without saying, but beyond that... Mejiro Ramonu's beauty captivated every eye.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu...! Ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Powerful, bold, and without waste... Above all, laughing with the pure innocence of a maiden, she was so dazzling it seemed as though light radiated from within.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —My, fufu...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: How careless. When I went out of my way to give you the chance to take photos.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Everyone had forgotten the photoshoot, watching the pair run—or rather, utterly entranced by them. Only Mejiro Ramonu's soft chuckles lingered in the ear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Locking me away inside a glass showcase... I would hate for you to be satisfied with just that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: The only jewelry I require are horseshoes and a rival. Add the turf, and... behold.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Do you understand now? With just this body alone, I am complete.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Oh, Trainer... Is that magazine from the previous shoot?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...May I take a look as well?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, ha ha! I see, so that's how it turned out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: From front cover to back, entirely dyed in Ramonu's colors. I heard it was a feature article... but it seems she took complete control of it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: She is truly frightening, isn't she... ...Make sure you keep your guard up as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: There is a bewitching hue tinging her eyes. Yes—just like zoisite.
